description: This course covers the principles and practices involved in analysing, documenting, and validating requirements for business IT systems. It provides students with a comprehensive understanding of the Systems Development Life Cycle (SDLC), techniques for gathering requirements, methods for modelling and documenting them, and validation techniques for ensuring that the final system meets business needs. The course will also focus on UI/UX design principles tailored for business IT systems.
